description: This PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_MultiLength' extends a length attribute validator to specifically handle multi-length values such as pixel counts, percentages, or relative numbers as defined in HTML specs. It provides a validate method that processes and validates these values according to certain rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_MultiLength
classes.description: A class that validates multi-length attributes in HTML, handling pixel counts, percentages, or relative numbers.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a string representing a multi-length value, ensuring it conforms to rules such as being numeric or ending with an asterisk('*'), with specific handling for empty, non-numeric, negative, zero, and one-star values.
